build: Remember crack, 'Falcon Patrol +5 and Highscoresaver 100%', highscore-saver only (no trainers)

comments.text: Joystick/keyboard byte after the game has forged it. Not the raw port: altitude limits, take-off and touchdown all rewrite it, and everything downstream believes it.
Flight state. bit1 = forced climb (take-off), bit3 = forced descent/touchdown, bit7 = ground contact path.
Horizontal velocity, stepped one unit per 8 passes of tick_counter, clamped to $FD..$03 (-3..+3).
Vertical velocity. Zeroed on touchdown and on ground contact.
Free-running counter; its low bits pick which part of the flight update runs this pass.
Which of the three raster bands the interrupt is about to set up: $FF, $00 or $01.
A stored 1000-byte copy of the title screen, stamped onto $0400 when the title is shown. Finding text here is not finding the live screen.
Player aircraft sprite frames, block $83 upwards. The current frame number in the sprite 0 pointer at $07F8 doubles as the aircraft's attitude: the touchdown test compares it against $88.

Character generator, 256 glyphs. Digits 0-9 are glyphs $00-$09; the alphabet is A-Z at $81-$9A, '.' at $80, '_' at $9B and the copyright sign at $9D. Landscape and status-panel tiles fill the rest. Moving objects are animated by rewriting glyphs here, not by changing screen RAM.

Frame pace. Spins until CIA2 Timer B's high byte reads $7F: the game's tick is this timer, NOT the raster interrupt, which only paints the colour split. A snapshot restored into VICE comes back with this timer stopped, so the loop never exits and the game appears frozen.

Raster interrupt, installed at $0314. Three bands per frame at lines $01, $8A and $D2, chained through raster_band, each setting the background colours for the band that follows. Acknowledges $D019 and leaves through the KERNAL's IRQ exit at $EA7E. Measured live at 151 Hz, three per PAL frame.
Installs the raster split: points $0314/$0315 at $4AC0, enables the VIC raster interrupt, DISABLES every CIA1 interrupt source ($DC0D = $7F), syncs on raster $FE and seeds raster_band.
High-score name entry. Left and right walk an index 0..$1B over the alphabet strip, fire accepts, and the name is built in the buffer at $0AB4 up to 12 characters.
Left and right step vel_x by one, clamped to -3..+3, once every 8 passes of tick_counter.
Reads control port 1 at $DC01 into input_byte, then forges that byte to enforce the flight envelope. Called from $419A. Port 1 shares $DC01 with keyboard row 7, which is why $DC00 is parked at $7F.
Ceiling: above sprite Y $30, set the up bit so the climb reads as released.
Floor: below sprite Y $BF, set the down bit so the dive reads as released.
No firing at low altitude: at sprite Y $7C or below, set the fire bit so the trigger reads as released.
Take-off: flight_flags bit 1 replaces the input with $FE, i.e. up held and nothing else.

Landing: flight_flags bit 3 or 7 replaces the input with $FD, i.e. down held. If bit 3 is set and the player's sprite pointer at $07F8 has reached $88, the input becomes $FF and both velocities are zeroed: touchdown.
Ground contact below sprite Y $C0: vertical velocity zeroed and flight_flags rewritten.
